annotations.title: Get free counts of NSW development applications by status, application type and council.

description: Get free counts of NSW development applications by status, application type and council. Call this first: it shows how many development applications are loaded, the exact council names the other tools accept, and the status and application type values. Optional filters narrow the counts. Counts refresh every 6 hours while the history backfill extends coverage back to 2018. Free, no payment needed. Source: NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure (NSW Planning Portal), CC BY 4.0.
